name: lib_sylow_card_eq_pow_and_index_eq
statement: (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type*) [Group G] (n m : ℕ) (hG : Nat.card G = p ^ n * m) (hm : ¬ p ∣ m) (P : Sylow p G) : Nat.card P = p ^ n ∧ (P : Subgroup G).index = m
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type*) [Group G] (n m : ℕ) (hG : Nat.card G = p ^ n * m) (hm : ¬ p ∣ m) (P : Sylow p G), Nat.card P = p ^ n ∧ (P : Subgroup G).index = m
informal: Order and index of a Sylow p-subgroup: if |G| = p^n * m with p ∤ m then |P| = p^n and [G : P] = m. Promoted and generalised from Mathlib2.bld3_card_sylow_of_card_prime_mul_prime_aux1 (the case |G| = r*s; same computation inline in alg_isCyclic_of_card_eq_prime_mul_prime, bld_center_eq_bot_of_card_prime_mul_prime).
